To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
sarcoidosis has a significant impact on the ability to work.
sarcoidosis patients are often not listened to or taken serious during work ability assessments, and that they often disagree with the outcomes of these assessments.
sarcoidosis patients experience problems with work ability and work performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the need to develop a disease-specific core set for assessment of work ability.
the need to improve the assessment of work ability in sarcoidosis and to develop a disease-specific core set of items to be used in the evaluation of work ability.
the development of a sarcoidosis-specific core set for work ability assessment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
sarcoidosis patients are not listened to, and that they are dissatisfied with the disability assessments.
the development of disease-specific core sets for assessment of work participation is needed.
sarcoidosis has a negative impact on work participation, and the disease burden is underestimated in current disability assessments.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Dutch Sarcoid Society is working to improve the situation for patients with sarcoidosis in the workplace.
the Dutch Sarcoid Society is working towards a disease-specific work ability core set for sarcoidosis.
the development of sarcoidosis-specific core sets of patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) and a disease-specific work ability questionnaire are needed.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the current assessment tools for work ability and work performance are not sufficient for sarcoidosis.
sarcoidosis patients are in need of a sarcoidosis-specific core set for assessment of work ability.
the development of a sarcoidosis-specific core set of domains is needed to assess the impact of sarcoid on work ability.
